moves.comment: Take space in the centre and open the diagonals of your queen and f1 bishop. This first move is shared with your Vienna repertoire.

children.comment: Develop the queen-side knight. It defends e4 and controls d5. Keep the f-pawn free while you see how Black develops.
Gain king-side space and control e5 with the f-pawn. Develop your pieces promptly; Black can still challenge the centre.
